usage: A common phrase used when saying good night or before going to sleep
Often said at the end of the day when parting with someone
Used in both casual and polite situations
Can be made warmer with particles like 呀 or 喇

examples.jyutping: ngo5 fan3 gaau3 laa3, maan6 on1
examples.meaning: I’m going to sleep, good night.

examples.jyutping: gam1 maan5 san1 fu2 saai3, maan6 on1
examples.meaning: You worked hard tonight, good night.

examples.jyutping: ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1, maan6 on1
